# SpatialCopyInference

SpatialCopyInference infers chromosome arm-level somatic copy number
aberrations (SCNAs) directly from Xenium spatial transcriptomics data.
The package identifies and spatially maps SCNA-defined cell populations
through spatial clustering and provides downstream tools for
visualisation, differential expression analysis, pathway enrichment and
identification of genes and genomic regions associated with inferred
SCNAs. SpatialCopyInference enables the study of tumour evolution and
early cancer development in situ.

Documentation, including the entire workflow using a human ovarian
cancer dataset, is available
[here](https://TBD.github.io/SpatialCopyInference/).

You can read more about SpatialCopyInference in our
[preprint](https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.64898/2026.10.23.761433v1.article-info).

## Installation

You can install SpatialCopyInference with the following command:

``` r

remotes::install_github("TBD/SpatialCopyInference")
```

## Example workflow

A minimum workflow is shown below:

``` r

# Import data
xenium.obj <- import_xenium(data_dir, annotation_file)

# Quality control
xenium.obj <- filter_cells(xenium.obj)
xenium.obj <- filter_genes(xenium.obj)

# Normalisation
xenium.obj <- normalise_data(xenium.obj)

# SCNA inference
arm_means <- compute_arm_means(xenium.obj)
arm_ratios <- compute_arm_ratios(arm_means, xenium.obj)

# Spatial clustering
BANKSY.obj <- compute_spatial_clusters(arm_ratios, xenium.obj)

xenium.obj <- add_banksy_clusters(xenium.obj, BANKSY.obj)

# Visualisation
plot_cluster_heatmaps(BANKSY.obj)
plot_spatial_clusters(xenium.obj)

# Downstream analyses
cluster_results <- compare_spatial_clusters(xenium.obj, ident_1 = "1", ident_2 = "2")
plot_gene_density(de_results = cluster_results$de)
gene_clusters <- identify_gene_clusters(de_results = cluster_results$de)
plot_gene_clusters(gene_clusters = gene_clusters)
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`add_banksy_clusters()`](add_banksy_clusters.md) : Add BANKSY
  clusters to Xenium object
- [`compare_spatial_clusters()`](compare_spatial_clusters.md) : Compare
  spatial clusters
- [`compute_arm_means()`](compute_arm_means.md) : Compute chromosome arm
  means
- [`compute_arm_ratios()`](compute_arm_ratios.md) : Compute chromosome
  arm ratios
- [`compute_reference()`](compute_reference.md) : Compute reference
- [`compute_spatial_clusters()`](compute_spatial_clusters.md) : Compute
  spatial clusters
- [`create_hg38_annotation()`](create_hg38_annotation.md) : Create hg38
  annotation
- [`filter_cells()`](filter_cells.md) : Filter cells
- [`filter_genes()`](filter_genes.md) : Filter genes
- [`get_genomic_info()`](get_genomic_info.md) : Get genomic information
- [`hg38_chrom_info`](hg38_chrom_info.md) : hg38 chromosome information
- [`hg38_gene_info`](hg38_gene_info.md) : hg38 gene information
- [`identify_gene_clusters()`](identify_gene_clusters.md) : Identify
  gene clusters
- [`import_xenium()`](import_xenium.md) : Import Xenium data
- [`normalise_data()`](normalise_data.md) : Normalise data
- [`plot_cells()`](plot_cells.md) : Plot cells
- [`plot_cell_log_ratios()`](plot_cell_log_ratios.md) : Plot example
  cell log ratios
- [`plot_cell_profiles()`](plot_cell_profiles.md) : Plot example cell
  profiles
- [`plot_cluster_annotated()`](plot_cluster_annotated.md) : Plot
  annotated spatial cluster
- [`plot_cluster_composition()`](plot_cluster_composition.md) : Plot
  cluster composition
- [`plot_cluster_heatmaps()`](plot_cluster_heatmaps.md) : Plot cluster
  heatmaps
- [`plot_gene_clusters()`](plot_gene_clusters.md) : Plot genomic
  clusters of differentially expressed genes
- [`plot_gene_clusters_by_chromosome()`](plot_gene_clusters_by_chromosome.md)
  : Plot genomic clusters by chromosome
- [`plot_gene_density()`](plot_gene_density.md) : Plot genomic density
  of differentially expressed genes
- [`plot_ratio_heatmap()`](plot_ratio_heatmap.md) : Plot clustered log
  ratio heatmap per cell type
- [`plot_spatial_clusters()`](plot_spatial_clusters.md) : Plot spatial
  clusters
